tools.name: list_guides
tools.description: List the published Homechecker guide catalogue a page at a time, optionally filtered by jurisdiction, guide cluster, property type, construction era, or buying stage. Returns catalogue metadata only: each entry carries the slug, title, the question the guide answers, its canonical URL, cluster, juri

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search professionally authored Australian homebuyer guidance using a natural-language question. Use this for general property, inspection, disclosure, apartment, condition, maintenance, era and buying-process questions. It does not assess an actual property.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Retrieve one canonical Homechecker guide by slug. Use a slug returned by list_guides or search_guides. By default a summary: the question the guide answers, its short answer, its limitations, the canonical URL, and an index of its sections by id and heading. Read the section you need with format sec

tools.name: build_buyer_checklist
tools.description: Build a deterministic, sourced checklist from the Homechecker guide corpus for a buyer context. This assembles general questions and checks; it does not analyse a listing, document or actual building.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_guides" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
